hero.title: Smarter Pharmacy Management.
hero.subtitle: Manage your pharmacy chain with intelligent inventory tracking, expiry control, and branch-level business insights.

about.title: Who We Are
about.body: Medicap is a pharmacy chain management platform designed to help pharmacy businesses manage medicines, inventory, sales, and multiple branches through one centralized system.

users.title: Built for Every Role
users.ownerDesc: Full visibility across all branches, approve high-value orders and transfers, monitor profit per branch.
users.managerDesc: Manage daily operations, raise purchase orders, receive goods, handle transfers and stock counts.
users.pharmacistDesc: Process sales at POS, handle prescriptions, manage controlled drugs register, print receipts.

items.visibilityDesc: See every branch, every batch, every transaction from one dashboard.
items.stockDesc: FEFO allocation ensures oldest stock sells first, reducing waste.
items.expiryDesc: 30/60/90-day expiry buckets with value-at-cost per branch.
items.coordinationDesc: Request, approve, dispatch, and receive stock transfers between branches.
items.reportingDesc: Honest profit per branch based on actual batch costs, never averaged.
items.securityDesc: Server-enforced permissions on every request with full audit trail.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Medicap is a pharmacy chain management platform that helps you manage medicines, inventory, sales, and multiple branches from one centralized system.
faq.a2: Yes. Medicap supports multi-branch operations with centralized control from HQ, branch-level inventory, and inter-branch stock transfers.
faq.a3: Absolutely. Every medicine batch is tracked with its expiry date. The system uses FEFO (First Expiry, First Out) to ensure the oldest stock sells first.
faq.q4: Does it support different user roles?
faq.a4: Yes. Three roles are supported: Owner/HQ with full chain access, Branch Manager with branch-level control, and Pharmacist with POS access.
faq.a5: Yes. The reports module shows profit per branch based on actual batch costs, plus expiry loss tracking with 30/60/90-day buckets.

po.title: Purchase Orders
po.subtitle: Branch managers create POs; orders over $1000 require HQ approval.
po.createSubtitle: For branch {{branch}}. Add one or more items, then save as draft or submit for approval.
po.needsHqNotice: This PO totals over ${{threshold}}. It will wait for HQ (Owner) approval after submission.

stockCounts.title: Stock counts
stockCounts.subtitle: Start a count, enter physical qty per batch, confirm. Adjustments are logged with a reason and sales are blocked for counted medicines in the meantime.
stockCounts.salesBlockedNotice: Sales are blocked at the POS for every medicine covered by this count until you submit or cancel.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Profit per branch and expiry loss, from real SQL. Never averaged, never hard-coded.

profit.title: Profit (daily)
profit.hint: Revenue minus actual batch cost. Returns net both sides.
profit.empty: No sales in the selected window.

loss.title: Expiry loss (monthly)
loss.hint: Value at cost of EXPIRED and WRITE_OFF stock movements.
loss.empty: No losses in the selected window.

returns.title: Returns
returns.subtitle: Within 7 days of the sale, cashier records and manager approves. Controlled drugs cannot be returned. Expired batches are written off.
returns.reasonPlaceholder: Wrong strength / customer changed mind / damaged packaging …
returns.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for the return.
returns.pickAtLeastOne: Enter a quantity for at least one line.
returns.noPermission: Only MANAGER or OWNER can approve returns.

transfers.title: Inter-branch transfers
transfers.subtitle: Requesting branch asks; sending branch dispatches; receiving branch confirms. Over $500 waits for HQ approval.
transfers.createHint: A branch requests stock FROM another branch. Below $500 total auto-approves; above requires HQ.
transfers.chooseBothBranches: Pick both from and to branches.
transfers.sameBranch: From and to branches must differ.
transfers.needItems: Add at least one item with qty > 0.
transfers.needsHqNotice: This transfer totals over ${{threshold}}. It will wait for HQ approval before dispatch.
transfers.shortageNote: Shortage note (if receiving less than dispatched)

reorder.title: Reorder suggestions
reorder.subtitle: Medicines with less than 14 days of stock cover based on the last 30 days of sales.
reorder.pickBranch: Pick a branch to see suggestions.
reorder.empty: No reorder suggestions. Every active medicine has at least 14 days of cover (or no sales in 30 days).

pos.title: Point of Sale
pos.subtitle: FEFO stock deduction; expired batches are never sold. Two cashiers racing for the last unit? Only one wins.
pos.searchPlaceholder: Search by generic, brand or barcode. Then click +
pos.cartHint: Change qty with the number box; remove with ×.
pos.emptyHint: Cart is empty. Click + next to a medicine.
pos.emptyCart: Add at least one item to the cart.
pos.invalidCart: Check item quantities and prescription data for controlled drugs.

receive.title: Receive goods
receive.rulesLine: Each line: batch number, expiry date, actual unit cost. Receiving over 110% of ordered is blocked. Expiry must be at least 3 months out (or you may override it).
receive.noLines: Add at least one line (qty > 0, batch, expiry).
receive.notReceivable: This PO is in status {{status}}. Only APPROVED or PARTIALLY_RECEIVED POs can be received.
receive.shortExpiryWarn: Expires in {{days}} days. Under the 3-month rule.
receive.allowShortExpiryLabel: I confirm that one or more batches expire in under 3 months.
